_provenance.note: Massachusetts citation authorities. DTA policy has TWO citable layers: 106 CMR 360-366 (the actual regulation text — fetched live this session as raw PDF text directly from eohhs.ehs.state.ma.us) and the DTA Online Guide (BEACON5), amended by numbered Online Guide Transmittals ('OLGT 2025-31'). Regulation sections carry the dollar-figure POINTERS ('posted at www.mass.gov/dta'); the actual current dollar tables live in DTA's periodically-republished 'Helpful Charts and Figures' guide, not in a numbered citation of their own — cited here by its OLGT/guide title, matching the framework's rule that a table gets cited as a table, not as the regulation section that merely authorizes it.
